body:
Reconcile plugin names and metadata across root plugin.json and .agents/plugins/agb/plugin.json to ensure consistent discovery and prevent plugin registration collisions in Jetski environments.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Root plugin.json and .agents/plugins/ manifests share consistent IDs and version strings.
2. Plugin handshake and discovery tests pass.
3. npm test passes cleanly.
title: chore: unify plugin declarations and metadata across plugin.json manifests
